map.输入租客收入、信用、工作等信息，综合评估租客信用风险等级: Enter the tenant income, credit, employment and other information to comprehensively assess the tenant credit risk level
map.📖 查看「租客（信用/背景）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Tenant (Credit / Background) Assessment
map.租客信用评分按维度加权：收入租金比（租金 ÷ 月收入，不超过 25% 得 100: The tenant credit score is weighted by dimensions: income-to-rent ratio (rent ÷ monthly income: ≤25% scores 100, 25%–33% scores 80, 33%–50% scores 50, >50% scores 20) + job stability (years employed, capped at 100) + linearly converted credit score + age and guarantor bonus; the total is converted to Excellent (≥80), Medium (60–79), Poor (<60); for the Poor tier, raise the deposit or require a guarantor.
map.📚 深度解析：租客信用与背景评分: 📚 Deep Dive: Tenant Credit and Background Scoring
map.出租前按租金收入比、工作年限、信用分、年龄与担保情况给租客打分，快速筛掉高风险申: Before renting, score tenants by rent-to-income ratio, employment tenure, credit score, age and guarantor status to quickly screen out high-risk applicants.
map.多个申请人横向比较综合评分，配合建议押金档位做取舍。: Compare multiple applicants horizontally on the composite score, and weigh against the suggested deposit tier.
map.合租或整租给公司时，用更低的风险等级换取更短的免租期或更高的押金。: When co-renting or leasing to a company, trade a lower risk tier for a shorter rent-free period or a higher deposit.
map.月收入 12 000、月租 4 000（租金收入比 33.3%，落在 >33%: Monthly income 12,000, monthly rent 4,000 (rent-to-income ratio 33.3%, falls in the >33% tier → income score 50); 5 years employed → 100; credit score 700 → (700−350)/6 = 58; age 32 (25–55 range) → 100; no guarantor → 50. Composite = 50×0.35 + 100×0.20 + 58×0.25 + 100×0.10 + 50×0.10 = 67.1 → Tier B (medium-low risk), suggested deposit 2 months. If monthly rent drops to 3,000 (ratio 25.0% → income score 100), composite rises to 84.6 → Tier A, deposit 1 month.
map.各项权重是多少？: What are the weights of each factor?
map.租金收入比 35%、工作稳定性 20%、信用评分 25%、年龄 10%、担保人: Rent-to-income ratio 35%, job stability 20%, credit score 25%, age 10%, guarantor 10%. The rent-to-income ratio has the highest weight because it is the single strongest predictor of default.
map.评分等级怎么对应押金？: How do score tiers map to the deposit?
map.≥80 分 A 级建议 1 个月押金，60–79 分 B 级 2 个月，45–5: ≥80 Tier A suggests 1 month deposit, 60–79 Tier B 2 months, 45–59 Tier C 3 months, <45 Tier D suggests rejecting or requiring a guarantor.
map.租金/收入比是核心指标，建议不超过33%（即收入≥3倍租金）: Rent-to-income ratio is the core metric; keep it ≤33% (i.e. income ≥ 3× rent)
map.信用评分参考央行征信或第三方信用分: Reference the central bank credit report or a third-party credit score for the credit score
map.工作年限越长，收入稳定性越高: Longer employment tenure means more stable income
map.有担保人可降低违约风险: Having a guarantor lowers default risk
map.建议查验身份证明、工作证明和征信报告原件: Recommend verifying the original ID, employment certificate and credit report
map.租客信用评估工具，从收入比、工作稳定性、信用评分、年龄、担保人五维度综合评估租客: A tenant credit assessment tool that comprehensively evaluates the tenant risk tier from five dimensions: income ratio, job stability, credit score, age and guarantor.
